body.zh: 2 关键耦合；• 参数变化可能同时改变；速率、选择性、均匀性、；损伤与缺陷
body.en: 2 Key coupling • A parameter change may simultaneously alter rate, selectivity, uniformity, damage and defects

body.zh: • 局部指标最优 ≠；整体工艺窗口最优；局部最优；整体最优
body.en: • Optimum local metric ≠ optimum overall process window Local optimum Overall optimum

body.zh: 3 常见失效；窗口边缘运行；Center-Edge不均；Endpoint漂移；Tool-to-Tool；Match失败
body.en: 3 Common failures Operating at the window edge Center–edge nonuniformity Endpoint drift Tool-to-tool matching failure

body.zh: 4 工程边界；不同工艺的关键旋钮；和CTQ不同，不能；机械套用同一参数；模板。
body.en: 4 Engineering boundaries Key knobs and CTQs differ between processes, so do not mechanically reuse one parameter template
